title: Validate the dossier and export the eCTD package
walkthrough:
You start on the dossier manager page, headed "Your product dossiers", with a top bar branded "ANDS Studio" and chips for "Help", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence" and "Guided journey →". Each dossier is a tile showing its ID, product name, a progress bar, and a status chip reading either "Ready to file" or a count like "3/5 modules". Clicking a tile opens the dossier workspace at Module 1.

The workspace has a top bar with module tabs M1–M5 (each marked with a check, dash, or dot), plus chips for "Application Viewer", "Audit", "Portfolio" and "Journey". A section tree sits on the left, the document panel in the middle, and a right-hand side rail holds the cards you use for this flow. A "Readiness" card there shows "● READY TO FILE" or "● BLOCKED", a progress bar, and the line "X% ready — X of Y filing steps complete". A button "How is X% measured?" expands to explain the percentage counts completed filing steps ("X of Y tracked steps below are done"), listing each step with the regulatory requirement it maps to. Below are per-step tiles and, when blocked, a plain-language blocker with a "Do this next →" button.

Below that is the "Draft completeness check" card. Its status reads "● NO STRUCTURAL ISSUES" or "● X issue(s)". It names the validation profile and version (e.g. its name plus "vN"), states its disclaimer, and offers a "What this does / does NOT check" toggle that reveals what it is modeled on and two lists: "Checks (structure & format)" and "Does NOT check". Each finding is a row with its rule id (CA-E-…/CA-W-…), an "error"/"warning" chip, the failing leaf/file, and a plain-English message. The first 5 errors show; "Show all X findings" / "Show fewer" toggles the rest, with extra warnings summarized as "+X more warning(s) — Show all above". Buttons let you "Run technical check (PDF header/encryption)" (showing "Checking…"), "Download report (CSV)", and "Download report (JSON)". A footnote states this is a presence/format completeness check — not a Health Canada review and not full eCTD technical validation — and notes any checksum shown is document control (md5), not validation.

Above it, the "Sequences" card lists each eCTD sequence (e.g. 0000) with a purpose chip ("Response", "Supplement", "Annual notification", "Initial"), a leaf count, and either "● ACTIVE" or a "Make active" button; the header notes "working: 0001". Under each sequence, chips show its lifecycle operators (e.g. "2× new", "1× replace", "1× delete", each with a hover explanation) and up to three "operation → modified-leaf" pointers. "New sequence" opens a purpose dropdown, a note field placeholder "Note (e.g. screening deficiency SDN-1)", and "Create & make active" / "Cancel".

To export, you click "Export" beside a sequence. Export fails closed: if validation has not passed, the app returns a blocking "Export blocked — sequence NNNN" panel instead of a download. It states the reason (or "Validation could not run, so export is blocked"), notes it was checked against the named profile and version and is a structural/format check, not a Health Canada review, and lists the specific errors (rule id, leaf, message; up to 8, then "+X more"). To proceed you must type a reason into "To export anyway, type a reason (recorded to the audit trail)" (placeholder "e.g. internal QA review only — not for transmission"); "Export anyway (override)" is disabled until a reason is entered, and "Cancel" dismisses the panel.
